name: Sample Retail Refund Policy
notice: Fictional demonstration policy. Replace with an organization's approved policy before use.

rules.rationale: The request is within the 7-day standard window and the item condition is eligible.
The request is within 14 days, the delivery was delayed by at least 5 days, and the item condition is eligible.
The request is outside the sample policy's standard and delivery-delay exception windows.

clauses.text: Eligible unused or defective items may be refunded within 7 days of delivery.
A delivery delay of 5 or more days may qualify for an exception when the request is within 14 days of delivery.
Requests outside the stated refund windows require human review before any final decision.
